summary: Iter 112 UI-consistency font audit. Signed in as sysadmin (and president for /match-officials), captured screenshots at 1920x1000 across 23 routes + dashboard sub-tabs + sysadmin/analytics tabs, and measured getComputedStyle().fontSize on titles/tabs/KPIs/panel-titles/table-headers/rows/chips/buttons. Dashboard baseline is met: dashboard tabs 13px/700, sysadmin analytics tabs 13px/700, KPI hero visually 40px. However, MANY pages still ship a 36-48px h1 page title, oversized (16px) row/card text on list pages, and a few 9-10px chips/table headers that fall below the 11px chip floor. Report below itemises each anomaly with route + selector + measured px + suggested target.

issues: Every list page (Tournaments, Schemes, Players, Match Officials, Org toggles) uses 16px body for rows — inconsistent with dashboard 13-14px. Suggest a shared .row-body-md utility.

16 of the 22 audited routes still render a 28-48px <h1> title where the dashboard uses a 19px eyebrow + 14px meta. Consolidating them behind PageEyebrow will eliminate the biggest visual inconsistency.

Chip/badge/th floors drop to 9-10px on /rate-cards th, /tournament-master th, /players row-status/row-cat, /schemes DEACTIVATE, /da-review & /action-center filters, dashboard warm-scope/sample chips. Raise to 11px per spec.

action_items: Replace 28-48px <h1> on 16 pages with the shared PageEyebrow (19px black title + 14px meta) — routes: /action-center, /discussions, /tournament-calendar, /venues, /da-review, /schemes, /player-registrations, /org, /meetings, /events, /disclosures, /access-control, /tournament-master, /tournament-wiring, /rate-cards, /match-officials.
Bring list-page row text to 13-14px on /tournaments (trn-row), /schemes (scheme-row), /players (player-row), /org (org-toggle), /match-officials (off-row), /tournament-master (registry-row).

Raise table th and chip floors to 11px: /rate-cards th (9→11), /tournament-master th (10→11), dashboard warm-scope-chip/warm-sample-chip (9-9.5→11), /players row-status/row-cat chips (10→11), /da-review & /action-center filter chips (10→11), /schemes DEACTIVATE (10→12).
Raise action-button band to 13-14px on /rate-cards (rc-add-line-item 10, rc-reset 11, rc-save 11).
Dashboard-greeting-chip is 16px vs spec 15px — trim by 1px.
Confirm /mc-admin main pane renders (audit found no measurable content beyond sidebar) and re-check workflow-card/step-editor/save-button once visible.
critical_code_review_comments: Multiple pages hard-code <h1 className='text-4xl/5xl font-extrabold'> instead of importing PageEyebrow from /app/frontend/src/lib/designSystem.jsx — this is the root cause of the 36-48px inconsistency; refactoring to one shared header component prevents future drift.

List rows across pages use their own text-lg/text-base classes — extract a shared `<ListRow />` (or Tailwind utility) sized to 13-14px so /tournaments, /schemes, /players, /match-officials, /org, /tournament-master all inherit the same scale.
The 11px chip floor is violated in ≥8 places (9-10px). A single `Chip` primitive would enforce it.

success_rate.frontend: audit complete — ~16/22 routes have P1 title inconsistency, ~7 routes have P1 row/tab inconsistency

context_for_next_testing_agent: Measurements captured in /tmp/audit/measurements.json. Screenshots were taken via browser_automation output_dir per navigation (audit_<route-slug>.png). The dashboard baseline (tabs 13/700, greeting 16, KPI 40 visually, chips 9-9.5 in warm) is confirmed. After main agent applies the PageEyebrow refactor + list-row + tab normalisation + chip floor bumps, re-run this same script (routes list at top of script inside the audit browser call) to diff — expect all page-title categories to show 19px fw700-800 uppercase 'eyebrow' text and no h1 above 20px, all list rows in the 13-14px band, and no chip/th below 11px. President login is required only for /match-officials.
rca of the issue: Root cause is duplicated header markup across pages — each page hand-rolls its own <h1 class='text-4xl/5xl font-extrabold'> block rather than using PageEyebrow from /app/frontend/src/lib/designSystem.jsx. The dashboard-scale refresh only touched Dashboard.jsx and its warm sub-panels, so every other page continued to render its legacy title/tab/row sizes. Reproduction: log in as sysadmin, visit any route in action_items list — the h1 renders at 28-48px (verified via getComputedStyle) while /dashboard renders '/ COMMAND CENTRE' at 19px. Mitigation: (1) refactor each listed page to import PageEyebrow, passing eyebrow + meta strings; (2) extract a `<ListRow />` / `.row-body` utility for the 13-14px body scale and apply on tournaments/schemes/players/match-officials/org rows; (3) enforce chip primitive with min 11px so warm-scope/sample, row-status, filter chips, and small th cells cannot drop under floor.
